mechanism_narrative: A high level of the federal funds rate compresses corporate profit margins and increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that dampens economic activity and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor market is exceptionally strong (PAYEMS > 156000) and housing starts are robust (HOUST > 1300), the economy overheats, triggering aggressive monetary policy that depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS > 156000 and HOUST > 1300, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a rolling 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicate sustained consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS is above 700000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (indicating economic contraction) signals weakening manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, elevated federal funds rates increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales exceed 710,000 (indicating strong consumer spending), it signals robust economic growth that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 710000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production indicates weakening economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is declining, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
